name: blockchainlab-api
summary: Free, static, CORS-enabled JSON API of 20 blockchain datasets rebuilt nightly from public sources (chainid.network, DefiLlama, L2BEAT, OFAC via 0xB10C, ethereum/EIPs, bitcoin/bips, Blockchain Lab corpus). No key, no backend.

entrypoints.name: GET /v1/index.json
entrypoints.usage: catalogue: dataset, url, schema, count, generated_at, stale

inputs.name: dataset
inputs.description: bips, bridges, chains, chains-tvl, dex-volumes, eips, ercs, events, fees, glossary, grants, hackathons, l2-metrics, protocols, rpc-health, sanctioned-addresses, security-incidents, stablecoins, whitepapers, yields

outputs.name: envelope
outputs.description: {dataset, api_version, schema_version, schema_url, generated_at, source, source_url, count, data[]}

compatible_with.how: typed TS/Python client generated from these schemas
43 MCP tools, many backed by these datasets
browser tools read chains and EIP/ERC/BIP data from here
hub pages and AI briefs are built on it
source of the hackathons and events datasets

tests.command: pip install jsonschema==4.23.0 pyyaml && python3 scripts/validate.py && python3 scripts/openapi.py && git diff --exit-code openapi.json
